news.headline:
Faalcon Concepts reported consolidated revenue of Rs 2,379.8 lakh and net profit of Rs 228.7 lakh for H1 ended September 2026.

On a standalone basis, net profit reached Rs 154.9 lakh on revenue from operations of Rs 1,698.0 lakh.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Citichem India approved H1 results, reporting a net profit of Rs. 42.6 lakh versus Rs. 68 lakh YoY.

Revenue from operations dropped to Rs. 229.9 lakh from Rs. 851.7 lakh YoY, with basic EPS at Rs. 0.7.

Source: ScoutQuest
